description.value:
You learn the following additional options for your Magic Mushrooms:

Boom Shroom. The triggering creature and all creatures in the area have to make a Dexterity Saving Throw. They take force damage equal to 1d6 x your Proficiency on a failure, and half as much on a success.

Madcap. The triggering creature and all creatures in the area have to make an Intelligence Saving Throw. On a failure, they are Confused until the start of the triggering creature's next turn.

Waxy Webber. The triggering creature and all creatures in the area have to make an Strength Saving Throw. On a failure, they are Restrained until the start of the triggering creature's next turn.

Additionally, you regain one use of Magic Mushrooms when you roll Initiative.
